plan.scope: D-06 Visual Editor canvas tool interaction; viewport-only pointer pan
plan.acceptance: Full Editor manual and physical acceptance deferred until the complete Editor scope is implemented.

implementation.feature: Use the existing Pan tool to move the editor viewport with pointer drag without modifying canvas nodes or the Page Model.
behavior: Pointer capture keeps the drag lifecycle attached to the canvas; pointerup restores the grab cursor and pointercancel/lost capture clear temporary state.
Interactive descendants are excluded from drag start; Pan-mode canvas clicks do not select or move a node.
Canvas scroll offsets change while node geometry, selection, draft Page Model, Save requests, and Publish requests remain unchanged.
Touch gestures on the canvas use touch-action:none in Pan mode; Select mode restores its default cursor and normal interaction.
implementation.save_publish: Save remains a draft-only operation; Publish stays a separate explicit action.
implementation.open_source_reuse: Existing Editor pointer/lifecycle and browser test harness reused; no third-party runtime code added.
